chunks: God invites to the mansion of peace and guides whom He wills to the straight path.

key_terms.دَارِ السَّلَامِ: Mansion of peace, referring to Paradise or the abode of safety from errors
key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ: Straight path, referring to the correct religion and way of life

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between God inviting to the mansion of peace and guiding to the straight path?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yunus is often interpreted as distinguishing between the universal call to Islam (dawa) and the specific divine guidance (hidaya) granted to the righteous, reflecting the balance between divine will and human agency. The 'mansion of peace' (Dar al-Salam) is viewed not only as Paradise but also as the state of spiritual safety achieved through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are the practical manifestation of the straight path. This dual aspect underscores that while God invites all, true guidance requires accepting the divine authority established in the Prophet's household.
